story.body: You let the kitchen spend the numbers. You did not tell the twenty shillings again. You left the grey unanswered. You said you would be home when the ale started, and that the sheet would stay on the bench.

story.body: You owned the miswritten word. You agreed to walk the six pairs back after the frame, and you left the bundle on the bench. You did not go as far as the door.
